tagline: Hot Tubs, Swim Spas and Saunas

Wellness Shop.blurb: Our own Ontario series, built in the USA with two 6 HP pumps and Thermal Shield insulation for Canadian winters.

Aquasolus.blurb: European-built by Superior Wellness. Every Aquasolus includes a free $4,292 anniversary bundle.

SwimLife.blurb: SwimExpert and SwimFit swim spas with ClearStream mineral water care and dual-temperature options.

Clearlight.blurb: Full-spectrum infrared saunas with True Wave heaters and a lifetime warranty on the cabin and heaters.

Serenity.blurb: Canadian-made outdoor cedar saunas in knotty or clear cedar, ready for an electric or wood-burning heater.
